regulations.notes: Effective January 1, 2024, all STRs in Sevier County outside city limits require an annual permit and yearly safety inspection. Permits transfer with property sale as long as they don't lapse. Application period opened January 1, 2024 with a deadline of June 30, 2024 for existing properties. Properties within Gatlinburg, Pigeon Forge, or other city limits follow those cities' separate regulations.
